page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m1 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The underlying processor configuration does not support advanced vector extensions (AVX, AVX512), matrix extensions (AMX), hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA), or virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM).

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.m1.medium offers a standard general-purpose profile suitable for workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without specialized instruction sets. Common deployment scenarios include medium-traffic web servers, application hosting, and development environments that do not rely on hardware-accelerated operations or local storage performance.
